notes: 38 practical phrases for Rohingya newcomers to Canada, covering greetings, pharmacy/medical, transportation, groceries, employment, and rules/help.
Phrases marked 'source_attested' are directly taken from the CLEAR Global Gamayun kit5k parallel corpus (professionally translated by CLEAR Global translators).
Phrases marked 'ai_draft' are composed from attested vocabulary patterns found in the corpus but are not directly attested as complete sentences.
All entries require native-speaker review before use as gold evaluation data.
Corpus source: Gamayun Language Data Kits — Rohingya (5k), CC BY 4.0, CLEAR Global.
Do not treat AI-drafted entries as validated training or evaluation gold data before native-speaker review.

Each entry has sources_checked (Gamayun, VOA), second_review (IOM Rohingya Dictionary word-level check) and reference_translation (the pair to evaluate against, with origin and confidence). Regenerate with ml/translation/review_phrases.py.
Confidence: 0.95 = Gamayun sentence + IOM word check agree; 0.70 = Gamayun sentence only; 0.40 = model fallback draft; capped at 0.50 where the sources disagree.
IOM Rohingya Dictionary data is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Only short glosses are quoted in second_review; do not copy the dictionary into this repo.
